A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety, shoes, eye glass ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the fan motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the fan motor.

The fan must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.
Be sure fan must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller, Rags
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight edge.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and compare them with the setting value 
 then replace the worn- out components.

Check alignment and compare it with the setting 
 value.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do 
 (if it is needed).

Check discharge pressure and compare it with 
 the setting value then replace the worn- out components (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).

Make test for bearings grease and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and replace it if it 
 is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.

Check the fan casing against rust and re-paint 
 (if it is needed).

Introduction
This document out lines the details 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The function of this fan is used to draw off steam air mixture of steam 
glands exhaust of turbine.
